description: Cs₈Na₄HoY₃Cl₂₄ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. There are two inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded to twelve Cl atoms to form CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four NaCl₆ octahedra, and faces with four YCl₆ octahedra. There are eight shorter (3.79 Å) and four longer (3.80 Å) Cs-Cl bond lengths. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded to twelve Cl atoms to form CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent HoCl₆ octahedra, faces with two equivalent YCl₆ octahedra, and faces with four NaCl₆ octahedra. There are eight shorter (3.79 Å) and four longer (3.80 Å) Cs-Cl bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one HoCl₆ octahedra, corners with five YCl₆ octahedra, and faces with eight CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are five shorter (2.74 Å) and one longer (2.75 Å) Na-Cl bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent YCl₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent HoCl₆ octahedra, and faces with eight equivalent CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.74 Å) and four longer (2.75 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six YCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.74 Å. Ho is bonded to six Cl atoms to form HoCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ho-Cl bond lengths are 2.62 Å. There are two inequivalent Y sites. In the first Y site, Y is bonded to six Cl atoms to form YCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Y-Cl bond lengths are 2.63 Å. In the second Y site, Y is bonded to six Cl atoms to form YCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Y-Cl bond lengths are 2.63 Å. There are seven inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Y atom. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Y atom. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Ho atom. In the fourth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Y atom. In the fifth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Cs, one Na, and one Y atom. In the sixth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Ho atom. In the seventh Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Y atom.
